clips.title: The story
paras: On the second floor of Goldshire’s Lion’s Pride Inn, Keryn Sylvius trains young rogues. In the reading room, she teaches stealth and bladecraft and quietly guides promising operatives toward Stormwind’s intelligence service.

Keryn Sylvius keeps to the reading room above the Lion’s Pride Inn. Downstairs, travelers crowd the floor with town guards, while upstairs she watches the steady flow of road gossip. She mentors rogues learning their trade in Elwynn Forest. When promising operatives outgrow petty theft and roadside skulduggery, Sylvius discreetly sends them to Stormwind City to contact SI:7.
